title: Billing Options and Payment Charges for the SunPath Solar Lease
content:
The SunPath Solar Lease bills monthly. Three billing figures depend on the system size or apply to it: the autopay credit, the paper bill fee and the returned payment fee. The accepted payment methods are the same list for every size.

## Figures by system size

| Tier | Autopay credit per month | Paper bill fee per month | Returned payment fee | Payment methods accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SunPath 3.2 kW | $5.00 | $2.00 | $25.00 | ACH, card |
| SunPath 4.0 kW | $5.00 | $2.00 | $25.00 | ACH, card |
| SunPath 4.8 kW | $5.00 | $2.00 | $25.00 | ACH, card |
| SunPath 5.6 kW | $7.00 | $2.00 | $25.00 | ACH, card |
| SunPath 6.4 kW | $7.00 | $2.00 | $25.00 | ACH, card |
| SunPath 8.0 kW | $10.00 | $2.00 | $25.00 | ACH, card |

## What each figure is

- **Autopay credit** — the monthly credit, in US dollars, when automatic payments are set up.
- **Paper bill fee** — the monthly fee, in US dollars, for a mailed paper bill.
- **Returned payment fee** — the fee, in US dollars, for a returned payment.
- **Payment methods** — the methods accepted for lease payments: ACH and card.

## Points of reference

- The autopay credit is $5.00 for the SunPath 3.2 kW, SunPath 4.0 kW and SunPath 4.8 kW systems, $7.00 for the SunPath 5.6 kW and SunPath 6.4 kW systems, and $10.00 for the SunPath 8.0 kW system.
- The paper bill fee ($2.00) and the returned payment fee ($25.00) do not vary with size.
- Each preference figure relates only to its own preference: the autopay credit to automatic payments being set up, the paper bill fee to a mailed paper bill being chosen.
